title: 팬사인회
scene: 당첨된 팬사인회. 학습자 차례, 최애 앞 90초. 외워 간 한국어가 다 날아간다
goal: Meeting your idol: 90 seconds of Korean under pressure

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 외웠어 항상 응원하고 있어요 건강 챙기세요
turns.rd: oewosseo hangsang eungwonhago isseoyo geongang chaenggiseyo
turns.en: I memorized it, I always support you, take care of your health

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Ugh… it's {name}! Sorry I forgot everything

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: What did you forget? Say it slowly

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I always… cheer for… your health

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 건강을 응원해 줘서 고마워요 어느 나라에서 왔어요?
turns.rd: ㅋㅋㅋ geongangeul eungwonhae jwoseo gomawoyo eoneu naraeseo wasseoyo?
turns.en: Lolol thanks for cheering for my health, which country are you from?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: {country}, I've been learning Korean for two years
turns.note: -ㄴ 지 2년 = it's been two years since

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 진짜요? 잘하는데요! 포스트잇 질문 볼게요… 최애 음식? 떡볶이요
turns.rd: jinjjayo? jalhaneundeyo! poseuteuit jilmun bolgeyo… choeae eumsik? tteokbokkiyo
turns.en: Really? You're good! Let me see your post-it… favorite food? Tteokbokki
turns.note: 포스트잇 = the question sticky note fans prepare

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐… 저 사진… 아니 사인… 아니…
turns.rd: heol… jeo sajin… ani sain… ani…
turns.en: Whoa… um photo… no autograph… no…

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 다음에 또 와요 그때는 이름부터 말해요
turns.rd: daeume tto wayo geuttaeneun ireumbuteo malhaeyo
turns.en: Come again, next time start with your name
